messages:
anna: Quick thread — debating field-level flags vs a top summary for the new Create Model form. Thoughts? mike: My take — inline errors for field-specific stuff, but a top summary for step-level validation (e.g., conflicting settings across steps). Keeps keyboard users clear and surfaces global issues. jamal: We should also standardize required markers on compact rows. Asterisk alone gets missed; explicit 'Required' label reads better. lexi: Agree. Asterisk-only is poor for screen readers. If we keep an asterisk visually, add sr-only text or include required in the accessible name. sam: Small nit: make the visible 'Required' text style tokenized so translators can override (i18n). Also lighter weight visually, not shouting. anna: For destructive confirmations (delete model version / rollback), are we leaning typed-confirm (type DELETE) or a checkbox + CTA? Mobile friction is a concern. mike: Typed confirm is safest for irreversible org-impacting actions. But it's annoying on mobile. Suggest typed-confirm only for org-level destructive actions; checkbox confirm for user-scoped deletes. jamal: I like scope-based rule. "Org-wide" -> typed confirm. "User-level" -> modal with checkbox + clear copy. lexi: Accessibility notes: typed confirm must not rely on placeholder text alone; error needs to be announced. Add role="alert"/aria-live on mismatch. mike: Example for announce on mismatch: ```html
Entry doesn't match required confirmation text
``` anna: For inline error behavior, can we avoid layout shift? Prefer reserving hint space so error toggles color/state rather than shifting surrounding content. sam: Totally — avoid janky shifts. Reserve one line for helper text under inputs; swap copy and color on error. lexi: Also ensure inputs use aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby linking to the error element id. Example: `aria-describedby=\"email-error\"`. mike: For compact grid forms, question: show 'Required' on every field or only once per logical group? If we hide on subfields, discoverability drops. anna: Proposal: show explicit 'Required' word in the label for first visible field in dense rows on mobile; show on all labels on desktop/expanded. @lexi can you validate that approach with screen readers? lexi: I can test NVDA + VoiceOver tomorrow. Also recommend using visible label text over relying solely on icons. jamal: Sprint decision idea: 1) Inline errors for field-level validations. 2) Top summary for step-level or cross-field errors. 3) Explicit "Required" text in labels (not just asterisk). 4) Typed confirm reserved for org-scoped destructive actions; checkbox/confirm for user-scoped. 5) Add aria-invalid/aria-describedby and role=alert patterns. mike: I'll open a frontend PR with patterns + small test harness and examples. Will include the code snippets and CSS for reserved helper space. design-bot: Created tracking issue: https://redwood.internals/issue/3214 — "forms: validation patterns — inline + summary + typed confirm" :white_check_mark: anna: Thanks! I'll update the Figma tokens and the modal variants. :thumbsup:
